work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission of the explicitly medium-pinned subset of the committed OpenBench M3 matrix. Codex, Pi, OpenCode and Cursor each preserve an explicit medium model condition in the raw invocation and share three tasks with five trials each. Devin is not included in this candidate matched-config group because the primary source explicitly states its reasoning effort was unpinned in M3.

source_known_dimensions: explicit medium effort/model variant in each admitted raw invocation
same three tasks: fix-failing-test, build-a-cli and make-it-run
same all-local execution on one macOS host and one run session
source reports zero adapter errors and zero API-key usage
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: historical harness package/build versions are not preserved in the M3 raw rows
exact upstream source revisions of the exercised harnesses
exact service-side model checkpoint behind the source model labels
independent proof that all client/provider routes resolved to an identical model snapshot
subscription/account routing and service-side state may differ by harness
client-native prompts, tools, context management and stopping behavior differ by design
ambient service-load effects are not independently controlled

non_admission_dispositions.reason: The primary source explicitly states that Devin exposed no reasoning-effort selector in M3, so canonical gpt-5.5-medium collapsed to plain gpt-5.5 at Devin's default effort. W1 does not manufacture effort-for-effort comparability. The public rows remain inspectable and may support a separately scoped unmatched observation if later needed.
The null adapter is benchmark calibration rather than an exercised AI harness; its 15 failed control cells remain in the raw log.
Wall-clock telemetry is public but W1 does not perform statistical or efficiency interpretation, and service-load effects are not independently controlled.

results.note: Temporary write-enabled hook regenerated registry views, committed them on the PR branch, and passed repository validation plus all four new record-specific admission checks.
